The issuer demonstrates a solid balance sheet with total equity of $4,112M and healthy profitability (EBIT margin of ~18% and Net income of $293M), though leverage is moderate with a total liabilities-to-assets ratio of ~67.6% and current liabilities slightly exceed current assets. These stable credit metrics and solid equity cushion align with a investment-grade profile, albeit constrained by working capital positioning.

DECISION: BBB
